title: Michelin Is Coming to Town: Organizational Responses to Status Shocks
authors: Saverio Dave Favaron; Giada Di Stefano; Rodolphe Durand
eligible_reason: Single treatment date: first Michelin Guide for Washington DC (fall 2016). Main tables are two-period (2016 vs 2017 menus) DiDs, xtreg outcome menu_year2017##guide_dummy (DC guide vs DC non-guide) or menu_year2017##dc (DC vs Boston guide-equivalent), restaurant FE. One adoption cohort; the parallel-trends event study (Table 8 / Figure 4) uses periods relative to the same release date.
design_notes: Stata_code.do on Stata_Main.dta (618 restaurant-menus = 309 restaurants x {2016, 2017}); Tables 4-7 with subsamples (stars excluded, prior standing splits); Stata_ParallelTrends.dta: xtreg y i.treated##ib9.pp10, fe. R_code.R draws figures (ECDFs, lollipops, synthetic-control-style plots from csv extracts).
data_files_note: Hand-collected menus (restaurant websites, Yelp, OpenTable, Wayback Machine) and Yelp business info.
software_notes: Stata for tables; R for figures.
screener_notes: Screened from package only. Not staggered (single Michelin release).
